findings: WHERE id < 160 keeps 10 pages and skips 90; the decoder reads 160 rows instead of 1600.
WHERE flag IS NULL skips the 50 pages that hold no null; IS NOT NULL skips the other 50.
WHERE label = 'g9' skips all 100 pages and returns 0 rows.
A compound arithmetic predicate compiles to 0 clauses and keeps every page; the row filter still returns the correct rows.
The optimized and baseline paths return identical row sets.
